connector.name: ShowMeOnMap
connector.registryDescription: Ask in plain English, get a rendered, shareable map from live public data. 24 geospatial tools.
connector.summary: Hosted at showmeonmap.com over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package mcp. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the domain namespace com.showmeonmap. The registry required proof of control over that domain before accepting the record.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Your ShowMeOnMap API key as `Bearer smo_live_…` — mint one at showmeonmap.com → account menu → API keys.

env.name: SHOWMEONMAP_API_KEY
env.description: Your ShowMeOnMap API key (smo_live_…) — mint one at showmeonmap.com → account menu → API keys. Every map spends your prepaid credits.
